items.event_time_ist: ~2:21 PM IST, Oct 16 (bench order issued Friday; first reported 2:21 PM IST)
items.source_name: India Legal (IndiaLegalLive); PTI via The Hindu BusinessLine
items.summary: A bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi on Friday issued show-cause notices to Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut and journalist Nikhil Wagle in criminal contempt proceedings over remarks targeting the CJI and the judiciary, on a plea filed by the Supreme Court Bar Association after AG R Venkataramani granted consent. The bench exempted both from personal appearance for now and will consider their explanations before deciding next steps. Raut — petitioner no. 6 in the INDIA-bloc SIR writ — had alleged the CJI and 60-70 judges played badminton with BJP leaders in London; the AG noted the circulated photos were actually from Thyagaraj Stadium, Delhi (Nov 2025). Wagle had deleted his abusive X post and apologized.
items.title: SC issues show-cause notices to Sanjay Raut, Nikhil Wagle in criminal contempt over remarks against CJI

items.summary: Congress workers in Kerala's Palakkad on Friday staged a mock funeral of CEC Gyanesh Kumar — carrying a mock bier from the DCC office to the Stadium Bus Stand, burning his garlanded photograph on a pyre with Hindu-cremation-style rituals, then dumping the 'ashes' into a toilet — to protest the ECI's SIR handling. The act drew attention as Congress had earlier criticized the SFI for a similar mock funeral of a Palakkad college principal. Part of the nationwide Congress campaign demanding Kumar's removal over SIR.
items.title: Congress workers in Palakkad stage mock funeral of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, dump 'ashes' in toilet
